description:
Decode validation strictness into its enum once, so configuration access no longer re-parses it.

## Background

`ValidationConfig.strictness` is `Option<String>` (`crates/jit/src/config.rs:267`). `deserialize_strictness` (`config.rs:233-243`) parses it and keeps the raw string, and `ValidationConfig::strictness()` (`:302`) parses again. `Strictness` has no serde, a hand-written `token` (`validation/strictness.rs:68-74`) and a case-insensitive `FromStr` (`:92-106`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Strictness` is declared through the macro, and `ValidationConfig.strictness` is `Option<Strictness>` decoded by serde.
- [hard] REQ-02: `deserialize_strictness`, `Strictness::token` and the re-parse in `strictness()` are gone.
- [hard] REQ-03: An unknown or differently cased strictness fails configuration loading with an error naming the key.
- [hard] REQ-04: Configuration lookup reports the canonical token.
title: Validation strictness is typed at load
